extraction.Name: Charles Cournoyer
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, I took it as a matter of course that it was necessary for us to take them when issued.
extraction.NOTES: Did not ask for the patent; received it by mail; satisfied with the sale; patent sent by mail (date not remembered); not married; supports no one except himself; notary Jas. W. Gross, commission expires 4-28-32; sworn May 3, 1929.
